records.conditionQuote: If the ledger cannot reserve the full quantity, the orchestrator rejects the whole order; it never makes a partial reservation.
records.claimQuote: It asks the stock ledger to reserve the requested quantity
records.rationale: All-or-nothing failure behaviour; the reserve request stays true without it, and publishing already waits on success.

records.conditionQuote: A reservation that is not confirmed within 15 minutes is released by the ledger and the stock becomes available again.
records.claimQuote: It asks the stock ledger to reserve the requested quantity
records.rationale: Expiry bound on a reservation; the reserve claim stays true but holds are temporary and the 15-minute value must be kept.

records.rationale: Staleness bound on prices; reading from Redis stays true without it.

records.conditionQuote: Every 10 minutes it calls the supplier API for new deliveries
records.rationale: Polling interval bounds how fast restocks appear; the claim stays true without it.

records.conditionQuote: A delivery the adapter cannot parse is logged and skipped; it is not retried

records.rationale: 'Each delivery' is false for unparseable deliveries, which are skipped.

records.claimQuote: the feed adapter wraps them in the retry helper

records.conditionQuote: Retries apply only to supplier calls.

records.rationale: Scope of the retry helper; no stated claim becomes false without it, but it prevents over-generalising retries to reservations.
